nights.title: Olivia Rodrigo: The Unraveled Tour
nights.name: Olivia Rodrigo
nights.extract: Olivia Isabel Rodrigo is an American singer-songwriter and actress. Rodrigo began her career as a child actress, appearing in commercials and the direct-to-video film An American Girl: Grace Stirs Up Success (2015). She rose to prominence with her leading roles in the Disney Channel series Bizaardvark (2016–2019) and the Disney+ series High School Musical: The Musical: The Series (2019–2022).
